title: Fictional queue incident notebook
provenance: Invented tabletop incident evidence. No live service, telemetry system or production incident is represented.
scope: Five scheduled one-minute snapshots in one tabletop exercise; queue depth counts waiting jobs, not completed jobs.
missing_reason: The minute 2 depth sample was not retained during a logger restart. Its value is unknown, not zero.

events.event: A new input burst and a retry-policy change were recorded in the same minute; their relative order is unknown.
The logger restarted; only the depth sample is missing.
The operator recorded a rollback to the previous retry policy.

closure: The final retained snapshot still has 1 waiting job. No completion counter, drained-queue check or later observation is supplied.
hypothesis: The retry-policy change might have contributed to the larger queue. The input burst is an alternative explanation; these notes do not establish a cause.
proposal: Retain event order and depth samples, add a completion counter, and compare isolated retry-policy changes in a separate rehearsal before declaring a cause or closure.
